mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_record(biz_type, biz_id, seq, node_key, node_name, approver_id, comment, result) VALUES(#{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{seq}, #{nodeKey}, #{nodeName}, #{approverId}, #{comment}, #{result})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM approval_record WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} AND seq = #{seq}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ar.biz_type AS "bizType", ar.biz_id AS "bizId", CASE ar.biz_type WHEN 1 THEN '申购审批' ELSE '废弃审批' END AS "bizLabel", COALESCE(p.code, w.code) AS "code", COALESCE(p.chemical_name, ci.name) AS "chemName", ar.result AS "result", ar.comment AS "comment", ar.node_name AS "nodeName", ar.create_time AS "createTime" FROM approval_record ar LEFT JOIN purchase_req p ON ar.biz_type = 1 AND ar.biz_id = p.id LEFT JOIN waste_disposal w ON ar.biz_type = 2 AND ar.biz_id = w.id LEFT JOIN chem_info ci ON ar.biz_type = 2 AND w.chemical_id = ci.id WHERE ar.approver_id = #{approverId} UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS "bizType", r.id AS "bizId", '领用双签' AS "bizLabel", r.code AS "code", ci.name AS "chemName", 1 AS "result", '' AS "comment", '导师签' AS "nodeName", r.advisor_time AS "createTime" FROM requisition r JOIN chem_info ci ON r.chemical_id = ci.id WHERE r.advisor_id = #{approverId} AND r.advisor_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS "bizType", r.id AS "bizId", '领用双签' AS "bizLabel", r.code AS "code", ci.name AS "chemName", 1 AS "result", '' AS "comment", '复核双签' AS "nodeName", COALESCE(r.out_time, r.create_time) AS "createTime" FROM requisition r JOIN chem_info ci ON r.chemical_id = ci.id WHERE r.checker_id = #{approverId} AND r.status IN (2, 4) ) t ORDER BY "createTime" DESC LIMIT #{limit}
